Google Business Profile: profile is UNCLAIMED, so there is no public business.google.com photo microsite (checked). Direct fetches of google.com/maps (by place name, by @lat,lng, and by place_id via google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id:...) all returned only the bare client-side app shell ('Google Maps' title, no server-rendered business/photo data) because Google Maps is a JS single-page app that does not serve business photo data to non-JS HTTP fetches. A google.com/search fetch for the listing (using the ludocid/CID resolved from the Birdeye redirect, 13758977788066022451) was blocked by Google's bot-detection no-JS redirect page.

Birdeye business page (reviews.birdeye.com/joses-painting-services-166925692249420): raw HTML inspected directly via curl; the ONLY images referenced are Birdeye's own generic placeholder assets (default-business-250x250.png, a generic 'contractors.png' category icon, and a 'no-review-banner' graphic). No real business photo is embedded in this page.
BBB profile: fetched directly; explicitly shows only a generic default placeholder image, no business photos.
Manta profile: URL found (same address) but every fetch attempt (curl and WebFetch) was blocked with HTTP 403 by Cloudflare bot protection; could not inspect for photos.
Yelp, HomeGuide: guessed/found URLs both returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare) on every attempt (curl and WebFetch); could not inspect for photos.
directorii.com: fetched successfully for review text, but this aggregator shows no business photos for this listing either, only its own site chrome.
photos.conclusion: Zero real, usable photos of this business's work, team, or location could be retrieved through any publicly accessible, policy-compliant channel available to this research pass. The core blocker is that the Google Business Profile is unclaimed (no public GBP microsite to scrape) and Google Maps itself is a JavaScript application that does not expose photo data to a non-interactive HTTP fetch; every third-party directory that might mirror Google Photos either shows only generic placeholder art (Birdeye, BBB) or actively blocks automated fetches with Cloudflare (Manta, Yelp, HomeGuide). No headless-browser or Google Places API access was available in this environment to render the JS and extract real lh3.googleusercontent.com photo URLs.

failure_reason: PIPELINE.md Fase 3 minimo: 'menos de 5 fotos reales propias' bloquea el build. Esta sesion de research confirma identidad real y solida del negocio (telefono, direccion, horario, BBB A+, 34 resenas 5.0 via JSON-LD de Birdeye, 4 resenas verbatim via directorii.com, sin website propio confirmado) pero NO pudo obtener NINGUNA foto real utilizable del negocio: el perfil de Google Business esta sin reclamar (no hay microsite business.google.com que scrapear), Google Maps es una SPA que no expone fotos a un fetch no interactivo, y los directorios espejo que podrian tener fotos (Manta, Yelp, HomeGuide) bloquean el scraping automatizado con Cloudflare 403. Construir el site sin ninguna foto real violaria la regla de 'nunca inventar' (stock photos simularian trabajo que no se pudo verificar). Se recomienda reintentar en una sesion con acceso a Google Places API o a un navegador headless para extraer las fotos reales de Google Maps antes de construir.
